title: Skyworth SWTV-21AE ("Living Room TV"), Android TV 14, firmware UKNV.260824.001
notes:
Skyworth SWTV-21AE ("Living Room TV"), Android TV 14, firmware UKNV.260824.001
ro.product.manufacturer=skyworth, device sunnyvale, MediaTek, about 0.9 GB RAM.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (classic Android TV home, not Google TV launcherx).
Live TV and inputs: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/skyworth-swtv-21ae/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/skyworth-swtv-21ae/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Disabled before this debloat, so not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON):
com.smartdevice.recommendation, com.google.android.play.games, com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic,
com.google.android.marvin.talkback, com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom, org.liskovsoft.androidtv.rukeyboard.

Quirks on this firmware, all checked on the TV:
- Port 5555 opened with USB debugging alone; no wireless-debugging pairing (unlike the Philips set).
- Live TV screenshots come back blank (protected video layer); check dumpsys topResumedActivity instead.
- Tested on the day of the debloat, not yet lived with for days.
